testing_guidelines.data_testid_convention: kebab-case, role-based, unique identifier for all interactive and key data elements

instructions_to_main_agent: 1. Keep the existing navy/white ERP sidebar and header unchanged. Embed the Mess Management Redesign directly into the main content viewport.
2. Render the top Navy Blue Module Header Band (#0F172A) with clear breadcrumbs, center switcher, period indicator, and quick PDF export button.
3. Render the 4 primary KPI cards (Total Items, Available, Low Stock, Out of Stock) with left border color indicators and tabular numeric formatting.
4. Add a secondary unit summary bar displaying Total Received and Issued broken down by unit (kg, L, Bags, Pcs).
5. Provide quick action buttons ('Add Stock Received', 'Issue Stock', 'View Stock History', 'Generate PDF Report') with Shadcn dialog/modal overlays for user transactions.
6. Build the interactive filter bar with Center dropdown, Period picker, search input, and filter chips/pills for stock statuses.
7. Construct the inventory table for desktop (sortable headers, sticky table header, numeric alignment) and expandable card views for mobile screens.
8. Ensure all status badges include both visual icons (CheckCircle, AlertTriangle, XCircle) and text labels for full accessibility compliance.
9. Create a dedicated PDF printable template view containing the 'Mashara' wordmark header, key statistics summary, item audit table, and authorization signature section.
10. Attach explicit data-testid attributes to all buttons, inputs, modals, cards, table rows, and status badges as specified in testing_guidelines.
UNIVERSAL GUIDELINES FOR MAIN AGENT: Dark colors look good when used independently without gradients. DO NOT use dark colors as gradients.
Do not make generic centered layouts, simplistic gradients, and uniform styling.
Create depth through layered design elements with subtle borders and card elevation.
You MUST NOT apply universal transition (e.g., transition: all). Add specific transitions like transition-colors or transition-transform.
You MUST NOT center align the app container. Maintain left-aligned tabular data and natural reading flow.
Always use modern button styles (pill or rounded-lg with crisp hover states).
NEVER use AI assistant emoji characters (🤖🧠💭💡) for status icons. Use Lucide React icons (CheckCircle2, AlertTriangle, XCircle, etc.).
Ensure generous padding inside cards (p-5 or p-6) to avoid text collision with borders.
All interactive elements MUST include data-testid attributes.
